lessons.root_cause: latest round, common capability, source-derived maker and event artifact were not all revalidated semantically
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker rebinds cases to stale round, forges author, injects unsupported rule, or substitutes event artifact and recomputes digest

lessons.root_cause: assembler lived outside content-addressed manifest and route digest was not recomputed from tenant/upstream/flow
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker substitutes assembler or route digest, recomputes manifest digest, and attempts maker-checker or routing lineage bypass

lessons.root_cause: accepted_for_review safe value was set at creation but omitted from post-mutation integrity validation
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker changes review boolean and recomputes receipt digest while retaining structurally valid receipt

lessons.root_cause: lesson coverage depended on local-only commit SHAs and non-shallow git history
lessons.exploit_scenario: a valid connector-created or shallow checkout cannot resolve the local base SHA, causing the mandatory learning gate to fail before evidence generation

lessons.root_cause: common capability values were compared to constants but not recalculated from each party profile
lessons.exploit_scenario: a plan claims an operation or token class is common even when one party profile does not support it, then relies on outer digest validity

lessons.root_cause: control storage keys, party profile digests, and review-item capability inputs were not all bound to their semantic identities with exact post-validation
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker swaps controls between registry slots or party profile digests and recomputes outer digests, or creates an item from a partial common capability

lessons.root_cause: challenge document digest and challenger namespace were checked structurally but not derived from the flow source party and anchored party document
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker substitutes another flow's challenge document or source party, recomputes the outer challenge digest, and preserves an apparently valid route

lessons.discovery_scope: #5901-#6300 disclosure rebuttal correction readiness independent audit
lessons.root_cause: the three source reviewer identities were structurally validated but not directly derived together with the reconsideration receipt digest
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker substitutes a valid-looking reviewer tuple and recomputes the anchor digest while retaining the same source receipt digest

lessons.discovery_scope: #6301-#6700 correction comparison consent conflict independent audit
lessons.root_cause: the previous correction-readiness packet compiler was omitted from the next anchor and new compiler separation check
lessons.exploit_scenario: the prior compiler is erased from provenance or reappears as the new independent compiler while all visible reviewer checks still pass

lessons.root_cause: the final simulation packet projected source compilers but omitted source reviewers and the source lineage digest
lessons.exploit_scenario: a packet is detached from in-memory anchor context and presented with only partial actor provenance while retaining a valid packet digest

lessons.discovery_scope: #7101-#7500 human deliberation question docket independent audit
lessons.root_cause: chair separation included source reviewers, compilers, and question drafters but omitted per-question human reviewers
lessons.exploit_scenario: a human reviewer reappears as the deliberation chair and presides over questions that the same identity reviewed

lessons.root_cause: claim and material manifest digests were included downstream but accepted as arbitrary hexadecimal values rather than derived from source semantics
lessons.exploit_scenario: attacker substitutes a claim, recomputes manifest, answer, receipt, and outer digest, and preserves structural validity

lessons.root_cause: comparison outcomes were selected from answer-kind labels rather than derived from the paired claim, manifest, receipt, and version provenance values
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker presents conflicting paired provenance under a kind mapped to CONSISTENT, or recomputes an outer case digest with a desired label, while structural validation still appears valid

lessons.root_cause: the anchored case-set digest was accepted as an arbitrary hexadecimal value and later submissions pointed to the initial proposal instead of the immediately preceding document
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker replaces the complete source case set and recomputes outer digests while retaining a stale case-set identifier, or omits the counterargument and attaches evidence directly to the proposal

lessons.discovery_scope: #8701-#9100 human review issue matrix independent audit
lessons.root_cause: claim, manifest, receipt, and version pairs were positionally adjacent to source bundle digests but were not inputs to each bundle projection digest
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker changes semantic comparison pairs and recomputes lineage and anchor digests while retaining the original source bundle identity

lessons.root_cause: source issue outcome and bundle identity were initially accepted as mutually consistent labels instead of being recalculated from claim, manifest, receipt, and version pairs
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker changes issue outcome or source bundle identity and recomputes the issue, set, matrix, lineage, and anchor digests while retaining structural validity

lessons.root_cause: source roles were checked only for count and identity uniqueness, not for their required semantic namespaces and positions
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker replaces all source actors with distinct but unauthorized role namespaces and recomputes docket, lineage, and anchor digests

lessons.discovery_scope: #9901-#10300 response review independent audit and CI evidence wiring
lessons.root_cause: the next stage could accept rehashed route labels without reconstructing the ordered source reviews, while the dedicated #9901-#10300 evidence runner existed but was not executed or uploaded by CI
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker substitutes a review route or actor namespace and recomputes outer digests, or a deterministic evidence runner silently breaks while unit tests remain green

lessons.root_cause: submission receipts were checked as arbitrary hexadecimal values instead of being derived from the source review, route, submitter, and document digest
lessons.exploit_scenario: an attacker substitutes an unrelated document and receipt, then recomputes the submission chain, events, holds, and docket while preserving structural validity
